source_title: Aberdeen: Robinson on criticism, board talks & being Hampden underdogs - BBC
source_excerpt:
Aberdeen head coach Stephen Robinson has been speaking to the media before Saturday's League Cup semi final with Rangers at Hampden (17:30 GMT).
Here are main points from the news conference:
With his side in poor form, Robinson says he and his players "deserved the criticism" following the midweek home defeat to Falkirk, adding: "I don't hide behind that, I don't try and throw players under the bus. I deserved it and we have to respond to that."

"I just have my normal conversations which I do, I speak to the chairman once a week and I speak to Adrian (Bevington, chief executive) once a week.
